get.summary: Read the safe singleton profile state
get.description: Admin and Viewer. Returns exists=false for a profileless deployment; never returns credential material.

post.summary: Create the singleton profile from confirmed setup
post.description: Admin and antiforgery token required. ADO and AI values come only from confirmed server-side staging; a second profile conflicts.

put.summary: Atomically update supported singleton profile fields
put.description: Admin and antiforgery token required. The revision is optimistic concurrency control. Profile ID remains immutable; validated ADO query and AI changes are reconciled through their management workflows.

post.summary: Explicitly import one legacy YAML profile and policy
post.description: Admin and antiforgery token required. Accepts bounded content, never a server path. Import is create-only, preserves profile_id, and rejects Production/LIVE.

get.summary: Export the portable, secret-free Profile and Policy configuration
get.description: Exports the current draft when present, otherwise the authoritative profile. Credentials, integration bindings, runtime state, history, and generated identifiers are excluded.

post.summary: Validate a portable Profile and Policy document without changing state
Atomically replace the portable Profile and Policy configuration
post.description: Complete configured profiles replace the authoritative profile. Incomplete imports replace the persisted draft and retain normal validation errors.

get.description: Admin and Viewer. Every readiness field is derived from authoritative persistence and runtime state.

get.summary: Read authoritative onboarding defaults and required Admin fields
get.description: Admin and Viewer. Values are product-agnostic backend defaults only; null fields require Admin input.

get.summary: Read the singleton onboarding profile draft
get.description: Admin and Viewer. The draft is safe setup input only and is never a runtime profile.

put.summary: Atomically update supported onboarding profile and policy input
put.description: Admin and antiforgery token required. The integer revision prevents lost updates; integration authority is not accepted here.

post.summary: Initialize the singleton onboarding draft from server defaults
post.description: Admin and antiforgery token required. Existing drafts are returned unchanged; unavailable after profile creation.

put.description: Admin and antiforgery token required. This records navigation only and never marks a setup component complete.

post.summary: Create and activate the singleton profile from confirmed setup
post.description: Admin and antiforgery token required. The server reconstructs ADO, query, AI, credentials, and draft state and atomically consumes all setup staging.
